description: This file provides helper extension methods for working with ReadOnlySequence<byte> and batch processing of byte sequences, specifically within the Orleans.Serialization.TestKit namespace.

classes.name: ReadOnlySequenceHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing extension methods for creating and batching ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances.

classes.name: ReadOnlyBufferSegment
classes.description: A private nested class representing a segment of a ReadOnlySequence, used internally to chain buffers together.

methods.name: Batch
methods.description: Splits an IEnumerable<byte> into batches of a specified size, returning them as an IEnumerable<byte[]>.

methods.name: ToReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable<byte[]> or IEnumerable<Memory<byte>> to a ReadOnlySequence<byte>.

methods.name: CreateReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Creates a ReadOnlySequence<byte> from one or multiple byte arrays.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: A static method in ReadOnlyBufferSegment to construct a linked sequence of buffer segments from a collection of Memory<byte>>.
